verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ إِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ أَرْفَعُ نَفْسِي.
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David. Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.web: By David. To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
verses.he: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃

verses.ar: يَا إِلَهِي عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، فَلَا تَدَعْنِي أَخْزَى. لَا تَشْمَتْ بِي أَعْدَائِي.
verses.kjv: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.web: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.he: אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵבֹ֑ושָׁה אַל־יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃

verses.ar: أَيْضًا كُلُّ مُنْتَظِرِيكَ لَا يَخْزَوْا. لِيَخْزَ ٱلْغَادِرُونَ بِلَا سَبَبٍ.
verses.kjv: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.web: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verses.he: גַּ֣ם כָּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבֹּוגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃

verses.ar: طُرُقَكَ يَارَبُّ عَرِّفْنِي. سُبُلَكَ عَلِّمْنِي.
verses.kjv: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
verses.web: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
verses.he: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הֹודִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחֹותֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: دَرِّبْنِي فِي حَقِّكَ وَعَلِّمْنِي، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ إِلَهُ خَلَاصِي. إِيَّاكَ ٱنْتَظَرْتُ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ.
verses.kjv: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou [art] the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.web: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
verses.he: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אֹותְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל־הַיֹּֽום׃

verses.ar: ٱذْكُرْ مَرَاحِمَكَ يَارَبُّ وَإِحْسَانَاتِكَ، لِأَنَّهَا مُنْذُ ٱلْأَزَلِ هِيَ.
verses.kjv: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they [have been] ever of old.
verses.web: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
verses.he: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעֹולָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃

verses.ar: لَا تَذْكُرْ خَطَايَا صِبَايَ وَلَا مَعَاصِيَّ. كَرَحْمَتِكَ ٱذْكُرْنِي أَنْتَ مِنْ أَجْلِ جُودِكَ يَارَبُّ.
verses.kjv: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD.
verses.web: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
verses.he: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י ׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ صَالِحٌ وَمُسْتَقِيمٌ، لِذَلِكَ يُعَلِّمُ ٱلْخُطَاةَ ٱلطَّرِيقَ.
verses.kjv: Good and upright [is] the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.web: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
verses.he: טֹוב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֤ן יֹורֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃

verses.ar: يُدَرِّبُ ٱلْوُدَعَاءَ فِي ٱلْحَقِّ، وَيُعَلِّمُ ٱلْوُدَعَاءَ طُرُقَهُ.
verses.kjv: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.web: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
verses.he: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ سُبُلِ ٱلرَّبِّ رَحْمَةٌ وَحَقٌّ لِحَافِظِي عَهْدِهِ وَشَهَادَاتِهِ.
verses.kjv: All the paths of the LORD [are] mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.web: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.he: כָּל־אָרְחֹ֣ות יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִיתֹ֗ו וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃

verses.ar: مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱسْمِكَ يَارَبُّ ٱغْفِرْ إِثْمِي لِأَنَّهُ عَظِيمٌ.
verses.kjv: For thy name’s sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it [is] great.
verses.web: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.he: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֹנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃

verses.ar: مَنْ هُوَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلْخَائِفُ ٱلرَّبَّ؟ يُعَلِّمُهُ طَرِيقًا يَخْتَارُهُ.
verses.kjv: What man [is] he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way [that] he shall choose.
verses.web: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
verses.he: מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה יֹ֝ורֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃

verses.ar: نَفْسُهُ فِي ٱلْخَيْرِ تَبِيتُ، وَنَسْلُهُ يَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.web: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
verses.he: נַ֭פְשֹׁו בְּטֹ֣וב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְעֹ֗ו יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: سِرُّ ٱلرَّبِّ لِخَائِفِيهِ، وَعَهْدُهُ لِتَعْلِيمِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The secret of the LORD [is] with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.web: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
verses.he: סֹ֣וד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִיתֹ֗ו לְהֹודִיעָֽם׃

verses.ar: عَيْنَايَ دَائِمًا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ، لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ يُخْرِجُ رِجْلَيَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّبَكَةِ.
verses.kjv: Mine eyes [are] ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.web: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.he: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־יֹוצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃

verses.ar: اِلْتَفِتْ إِلَيَّ وَٱرْحَمْنِي، لِأَنِّي وَحْدٌ وَمِسْكِينٌ أَنَا.
verses.kjv: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I [am] desolate and afflicted.
verses.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.he: פְּנֵה־אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃

verses.ar: اُفْرُجْ ضِيقَاتِ قَلْبِي. مِنْ شَدَائِدِي أَخْرِجْنِي.
verses.kjv: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: [O] bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.web: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
verses.he: צָרֹ֣ות לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקֹותַ֗י הֹוצִיאֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: ٱنْظُرْ إِلَى ذُلِّي وَتَعَبِي، وَٱغْفِرْ جَمِيعَ خَطَايَايَ.
verses.kjv: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.web: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
verses.he: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃

verses.ar: ٱنْظُرْ إِلَى أَعْدَائِي لِأَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كَثُرُوا، وَبُغْضًا ظُلْمًا أَبْغَضُونِي.
verses.kjv: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.web: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.he: רְאֵֽה־אֹויְבַ֥י כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃

verses.ar: ٱحْفَظْ نَفْسِي وَأَنْقِذْنِي. لَا أُخْزَى لِأَنِّي عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ.
verses.kjv: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.web: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
verses.he: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־אֵ֝בֹ֗ושׁ כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: يَحْفَظُنِي ٱلْكَمَالُ وَٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةُ، لِأَنِّي ٱنْتَظَرْتُكَ.
verses.kjv: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.web: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
verses.he: תֹּם־וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: يَا ٱللهُ، ٱفْدِ إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ كُلِّ ضِيقَاتِهِ.
verses.kjv: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.web: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
verses.he: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרֹותָיו׃
